critique_quotes.quote: The connection between the project and the candidate's training goals is unclear.
The research strategy reads like an R01 scaled to a student timeline; the training value of the proposed work is not articulated.
The science is compelling on its own terms, but the application does not state what the candidate will learn by doing it.

located_excerpts.excerpt: Aim 1 will define the synaptic mechanism using paired recordings in acute slices; Aim 2 will extend the circuit map to behaving animals with fiber photometry. Together these experiments will resolve a long-standing question in the field.
